notes: Every s### and t### partitioned exactly once.

The supplied *men* sits on the infinitive ἀναστρέφεσθαι rather than on δεῖ, which is rule 74 in terms; the ASV's own margin (*how thou oughtest to behave thyself*) confirms the word is the infinitive's subject. This is the reading 1TI.3.7 was corrected to match.
ἐάν is an ordinary conditional and takes *if* (rule 72's closing clause); ἵνα takes the *that* introducing its English clause (rule 40).

θεοῦ ζῶντος is wholly anarthrous, so the supplied determiner and the case preposition ride with the noun under rules 21 and 58, discontinuous under rule 15; ἐκκλησία, οἴκῳ and στῦλος likewise take supplied determiners as rule 51 helpers.
ἐστίν is expressed, so no supplied copula is in question and rules 53 and 63 do not arise.
